purpose: Validate age/sex allocation profiles used only for scenario-driven external population additions.

profiles.job_family: Observed municipal in-migration ages 0-64; legacy sensitivity profile.
profiles.worker_hybrid: SCB workplace employment age/sex shares (15-24,25-54,55-74) disaggregated to one-year ages using local observed in-migration.
profiles.family_companion: Observed in-migration ages 0-17 and 25-64; ages 18-24 excluded to reduce university-driven student bias.

requiredChecks: every profile sums to 1 by geography/window
all shares are finite and nonnegative
worker_hybrid has zero mass outside ages 15-74
worker_hybrid broad age/sex totals reconcile to SCB TAB3205 target shares
family_companion has zero mass in ages 18-24
profiles affect only scenario allocation and never the demographic baseline
governance: These profiles are scenario priors, not causal estimates of job-induced migration.
Worker_hybrid may use SCB labour-market structure, but the total external mover count remains controlled by explicit scenario assumptions.
Any future causal migration-profile model must be validated separately before replacing these descriptive production priors.
